Every screen,
every state.

The full Halo Studio prototype laid out statically, recoloured with the Nebula palette from your Buy-more-Credits dialog. Each frame is a live render of one screen in one state — no clicking needed. Scroll top to bottom, or jump with the index.

46 frames tagged New cover the requirements list: conversational creation, the five-step new short drama, Task Center, the full settings page, announcements, feedback and theme switching, canvas management and sharing, material categories and the recycle bin, running and editing skills, and Plugin Center.

Every desktop screen has its 390 px mobile version beside it, at the same scale, so you can compare them side by side.

Full-page frames show the whole scroll height. Viewport frames (modals, popovers, canvas) show one 1440 × 900 screen.
